correctness.rationale: For every field the coefficient decomposition f=a+xb turns f²=0 into a²=0 and 2ab=0. Smith invariant factors of [[a,0],[b,a]] give exact multiplication rank max(2(n-u),n-v), including zero-factor boundaries. Characteristic-two linear subspace and odd-characteristic union-of-linear-subspaces follow directly from valuation inequalities, each intersection is computed, and counts are exact. Rank differences give Jordan types because the operator square is zero. An independent finite-field checker exhaustively verified 18 configurations, 6,244 square-zero elements; enumeration is not presented as the proof.
